description: Office of the District Secretary/Govt Agent - Annual Feast of st. Sebastian's National Shrine Kandana - 2022
categorisation: This gazette content announces the dates and arrangements for the Annual Feast of St. Sebastian's National Shrine in Kandana. It references quarantine laws and health sector instructions related to COVID-19 precautions, but the primary content is about a religious/cultural event announcement. This does not fit any of the government-related classifications (Types 1-3) as it doesn't involve government structure or personnel changes, nor does it fit the specialized categories (Types 4-9) as it's not about land, legal, commercial, electoral, public service, or judicial matters. Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous (Type 10) for cultural/religious announcements not covered by other categories.
